name: Apus
source:
The story is set on the Mars exploration base, Dune.
It follows a young man named Subaru, who has been left behind there alone.
However, the perspective of the story is told through a “meteorite” he picked up.
translation:
故事发生在火星探索基地沙丘。
故事讲述了一个名叫昴的年轻人，他被独自留在那里。
然而故事的视角是通过他捡到的一颗“陨石”来讲述的。
